package.name: inesctec_mrdt_slam_distmap_2d
package.description: This ROS package contains the C++ classes and structs definitions required to execute Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) based on a distance map matching formulation. Most data structures are based on the SRRG Software (https://gitlab.com/srrg-software/) developed by the Robots Vision and Perception Group (https://rvp-group.net/) led by Prof. Dr. Giorgio Grisetti. These structures are here redefined to understand better how they work, add unit testing, document the structs and classes, and possibly some added functionality when needed. The main goal of this ROS package is to try to be as independent from the ROS framework as possibly, in exception of the package's dependencies.
